scope: Four isolated Edge cases. Real click/tap/key input, native local persistence and read-only game/DOM/pixel observation. Three fresh viewports and one unchanged previously earned coastal archive.
limitations: Touch is emulated Chromium input, not physical mobile certification.
The coastal fixture was earned by the preceding complete playthrough; its storage values are copied unchanged and only its localhost origin is remapped.
